start: A member opens the app and the phone's data cannot be read

steps.action: Open the app
user_sees: Title 'MettleUp could not start'
'MettleUp couldn't read your data. Your workouts are still on this phone. Tap Try again.'
Buttons 'Try again' and 'Save my data file'
'Details'
must_not: The welcome or first-run screen over a phone full of workouts

steps.action: Tap 'Try again' after the cause is gone
user_sees: The app opens on the member's own data
must_not: Data lost or reset by the retry

start: A member whose phone storage is full

steps.action: Open the app
user_sees: Title 'Your phone's storage is full'
'Your phone's storage is full. Free some space, then tap Try again.'
must_not: The general 'could not start' words when the cause is known

steps.action: Open the app after an update that could not finish
user_sees: 'MettleUp couldn't finish updating your data. Your workouts are still on this phone. Tap Try again.'
must_not: The data file deleted or reset

start: A member on the error screen

steps.action: Tap 'Save my data file' when no data file exists
user_sees: 'No data file found on this phone.'
must_not: An empty file shared as the member's data

steps.action: Tap it on a phone that cannot share files
user_sees: 'This phone can't share files right now.'
must_not: A crash or a share sheet that never opens with no word

start: A member on the error screen

steps.action: Tap 'Details', then tap it again
user_sees: The raw error text, then hidden again
must_not: Details stuck open or closed

steps.action: Tap 'Try again' while the fault is still there
user_sees: The error screen again with the same words
must_not: The welcome screen
The button stuck on loading

start: A member on the error screen

steps.action: Tap 'Save my data file' and share it
user_sees: 'Keep this file somewhere safe. If you need help, send it to your gym, who can pass it to MettleUp to open.'
must_not: Advice to send the whole data file (body weight, notes, profile, phone number) to the gym
The file sent anywhere without the member choosing

start: A member opens the app and the phone's data cannot be read

steps.action: Open the app
user_sees: Title 'MettleUp could not start'
'MettleUp couldn't read your data. Your workouts are still on this phone. Tap Try again.'
Buttons 'Try again' and 'Save my data file'
'Details'

steps.action: On the old version, do "Start-up error screen when the app cannot open its data" up to step 1; update the app; open it and carry on.
user_sees: The journey carries on or starts again cleanly, with nothing lost that was saved
must_not: A crash on first open, a lost or half-saved saved data, or a step that the new version no longer understands

note: an update that fails while upgrading the data shows the 'finish updating' words

start: A member opens the app and the phone's data cannot be read; set-up: many items (500+)

steps.action: Start "Start-up error screen when the app cannot open its data" when 500 or more saved data rows exist.
user_sees: The list opens in a few seconds and scrolls; every count is the true total
must_not: A count that stops at a page size, missing rows of saved data, or a screen that freezes

user_sees: Title 'MettleUp could not start'

must_not: The welcome or first-run screen over a phone full of workouts

steps.action: Close the app (swipe it away) at step 2 of "Start-up error screen when the app cannot open its data", then open it again.
user_sees: Either nothing was saved, or the saved data is whole; the app says which
must_not: A half-saved saved data, a double saved data after trying again, or a stuck screen on reopening

note: both buttons have busy guards; a copy left in the cache if the app is closed mid-copy

steps.action: Tap the main button of step 2 of "Start-up error screen when the app cannot open its data" twice, fast.
